_description.summary: Status effects and body changes: applying potions (Sun's Nadirs), cleansing and reading status effects (category, amplifier, duration, level), gender transitions and breast/body property get and set (Hexgender).
use_cases: Applying, removing or reading potion effects
Checking what effects an entity has
Changing or reading gender and body properties
Transitioning the caster to female, male or non-binary (female_transition, male_transition, other_transition)

potion/weakness.d: Inflicts weakness. Base cost is one Amethyst Dust per 10 seconds.

potion/levitation.d: Inflicts levitation. Base cost is one Amethyst Dust per 5 seconds.

potion/wither.d: Inflicts withering. Base cost is one Amethyst Dust per second.

potion/poison.d: Inflicts poison. Base cost is one Amethyst Dust per 3 seconds.

potion/slowness.d: Inflicts slowness. Base cost is one Amethyst Dust per 5 seconds.

removestatus.d: Accepts an entity and a status effect type, and removes that status effect from the entity. Cost is based on the effect's innate harmfulness, its potency, and its remaining duration.

getstatus.d: Accepts a living entity, and returns a list of status iotas representing all effects on the target.

female_transition.d:
Transitions the caster to a female!
I wonder how I'd look in a skirt...

male_transition.d:
Transitions the caster to a male!
No more periods!

other_transition.d:
Transitions the caster to androgynous!
Hmm... this is... interesting...

get_gender.d: Obtains the target's selected gender as an ordinal (number)

get_bust_size.d: Gives the bust size of the target

set_bust_size.d: Sets the bust size of the caster

get_bounciness.d: Gives the bounciness of the target's breasts

set_bounciness.d: Sets the bounciness of the caster's breasts

get_floppiness.d: Gives the floppiness of the target's breasts

set_floppiness.d: Sets the floppiness of the caster's breasts

get_physics.d: Gives the physics of the target's breasts

set_physics.d: Sets the physics of the caster's breasts

get_cleavage.d: Gets the cleavage of the target's breasts

set_cleavage.d: Sets the cleavage of the caster's breasts

get_breast_offsets.d: Gets the offset of the target's breasts

set_breast_offsets.d: Sets the offset of the caster's breasts

get_uniboob.d: Gets whether the target's breasts are a uniboob

set_uniboob.d: Sets whether the caster's breasts are a uniboob

periwinkle.d: Fortunately, the Art of Hexcasting is a versatile one and provides the means to bring back near anything.

get_effects_entity.d: Pushes a list of status effects the entity is afflicted with.

get_effects_item.d: Pushes a list of status effects the food or potion will bestow.

get_effect_category.d: Pushes the general "goodness" of the effect towards the afflicted. -1 for harmful, 0 for neutral, and 1 for beneficial.

get_effect_amplifier.d: Pushes how potent the effect type is acting on the entity or Null if the entity doesn't have it.

get_effect_duration.d: Pushes how long the effect type will affect the entity in twentieths of a second or Null if the entity doesn't have it.
